name: file_search
description: Find files inside the user's configured search folders (defaults: Downloads, Documents, Videos, Music, Pictures) by name/extension or by recency, then optionally open one with the default application. Use when the user asks to find, locate, look for, or open a file (a document, PDF, image, audio, video, script...).

action.description: 'search' finds files by name/extension within the search folders; 'recent' lists recently modified files; 'open' opens a given file path with the default application

pattern.description: For 'search': a substring of the file name, or an extension filter like '.pdf' (case-insensitive)

path.description: For 'open': the absolute path of the file to open (must be inside a configured search folder)
